title: New analytic Janus and $S^4$ solutions for $\mathcal{N}=2^*$
summary: We construct a three-parameter family of regular analytic supergravity solutions which are dual to (a) the $\mathcal{N}=2^*$ gauge theory on the four-sphere, and (b) $\mathrm{U}(1)^2$-invariant Janus interfaces in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM with or without the $\mathcal{N}=2^*$ mass turned on. To this end we employ a five-dimensional supergravity model coupled to six scalars which arises as a certain consistent truncation of type IIB supergravity on $S^5$.
